page_title: BAR 4-0 GET | Barcelona v Getafe 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' 4 - 0 Goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:0.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Caution goes to Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
89' The referee signals a free kick. Getafe are going to take it from long range.
86' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
86' A lofted cross from Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Xavi has decided to substitute Joao Cancelo and he is replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).
83' Substitution. Pedri (Barcelona) in, Ilkay Gundogan out.
82' The ball is cleared after Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
81' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) inside the box. Now Barcelona have a corner.

79' Diego Rico (Getafe) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Ilaix Moriba.
77' Here is a change. Andreas Christensen is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raphinha trots off the pitch and is replaced by Vitor Roque (Barcelona).

75' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. David Soria makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
74' Good chance! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
71' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
70' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Getafe was in an offside position.
69' A lofted pass into the box is met by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Carles Alena (Getafe) for Djene.
67' Here's the change. Nemanja Maksimovic leaves the pitch and Jaime Mata (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Mason Greenwood will be replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
65' The ball is cleared after Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
63' Substitution. Joao Felix makes way for Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).

61' 3 - 0 Goal! Raphinha displays great vision and sends a pass to Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
61' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
60' The ball is cleared after Raphinha (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
57' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
56' Luis Milla (Getafe) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Barcelona.

53' 2 - 0 Goal! Andreas Christensen plays in Joao Felix (Barcelona), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 2:0.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Barcelona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Diego Rico (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
50' A dangerous looking corner kick from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared to safety by the defence.
49' Luis Milla (Getafe) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir.
48' Djene (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Jose Angel Carmona and Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
44' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Diego Rico (Getafe) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
41' Omar Alderete (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Barcelona.
38' Joao Felix (Barcelona) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of David Soria.
37' Omar Alderete (Getafe) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
37' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

33' Luis Milla (Getafe) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
31' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends the corner into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen intercepts it and averts the threat.
30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
29' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' The resulting corner, taken by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), comes to nothing.
24' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
23' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' 1 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Jules Kounde, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
19' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
17' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

15' Barcelona are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
13' Joao Felix (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
8' Raphinha (Barcelona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
7' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Marc-Andre ter Stegen stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
3' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
